043package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
044
045/**
046 * The various formats that are supported for use in JFormattedTextField.
047 * There are Types, such as DATE and subtypes such as DATE_MMDDYYYY.
048 * If the type is used, this is the default format.
049 */
050// TODO: Need to make Format available for when somethings parsed by DateTime,
051//       consider MMDDYYYY vs DDMMYYYY. The "editPattern" with the "*Field"
052//       components has that info. Want the field tooltip for the format.
053//       Maybe end up with a "FormatInfo" that has format specific stuff.
054//
055//       Consider: Format has SLASH vs STROKE property.
056//
057//       One question, how can a user define a Format? Have a base
058//       "class Format<E extends Enum<E>>" that can be extended?
059//
060public enum SsFormat {
061  /** special circumstances or if format not needed (testing) */
062  CUSTOM,
063  /** default date format */
064  DATE,
065  /** Date MMDDYYYY */
066  DATE_MMDDYYYY_SLASH(DATE),
067  /** Date DDMMYYYY */
068  DATE_DDMMYYYY_SLASH(DATE),
069  /** Date YYYYMMDD */
070  DATE_YYYYMMDD_STROKE(DATE),
071
072  /** default time format */
073  TIME,
074  /** Time HHMMSS */
075  TIME_HHMMSS(TIME),
076
077  /** default timestamp format */
078  TIMESTAMP,
079  /** Timestamp big */
080  TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE_HHMMSS_SSSZ(TIMESTAMP),
081  /** Timestamp date-time, no milliseconds timezone */
082  TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE_HHMMSS(TIMESTAMP),
083  /** Timestamp date, no date, milliseconds, timezone */
084  TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE(TIMESTAMP),
085  ;
086
087  // could add a field to contructor that says "I'm default".
088  private static SsFormat getDefaultFormat(SsFormat format) {
089    return switch (format.getType()) {
090      case DATE -> DATE_MMDDYYYY_SLASH;
091      case TIME -> TIME_HHMMSS;
092      //case TIMESTAMP -> TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS;
093      case TIMESTAMP -> TIMESTAMP_YYYYMMDD_STROKE_HHMMSS_SSSZ;
094      default -> format; // XXX
095    };
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * The param format may resolve to another format.
100   * Find the actual format to use.
101   * @param format format
102   * @return a format that can b
103   */
104  public static SsFormat getActualFormat(SsFormat format) {
105    return format.isBase() ? getDefaultFormat(format) : format;
106  }
107
108  final private SsFormat type;
109
110  /** the default has no args */
111  SsFormat() {
112    type = this;
113  }
114
115  SsFormat(SsFormat _base) {
116    type = _base;
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Is this enum value the default for the given type
121   * @return true if this enum is the default.
122   */
123  boolean isBase() {
124    return type == this;
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * The type of this format, e.g. DATE.
129   * @return type
130   */
131  public SsFormat getType() {
132    return type;
133  }
134}
